SELECT '开放计划' planType, A.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, A.VDATE AS VDATE, A.PROFIT_TYPE AS PROFIT_TYPE, E.OPEN_MDATE AS OPEN_MDATE, E.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, E.OPEN_TYPE AS OPEN_TYPE, E.OPEN_VDATE AS OPEN_VDATE, A.CALENDAR_ID AS CALENDAR_ID, D.PUR_SPEED AS PUR_SPEED, D.IS_CYCLE AS IS_CYCLE, D.CLOSE_DAYS AS CLOSE_DAYS, D.DEAL_MODE AS DEAL_MODE, F.OPEN_DAYS_TYPE AS OPEN_DAYS_TYPE, F.OPEN_DAYS AS OPEN_DAYS, F.OPEN_MODE AS OPEN_MODE, F.OPEN_CYCLE AS OPEN_CYCLE, F.OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT AS OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT, F.DAY_TYPE AS DAY_TYPE, F.DAY_VALUE AS DAY_VALUE, F.CALC_METHOD AS CALC_METHOD, F.FIRST_OPEN_DATE AS FIRST_OPEN_DATE, F.TRADEDAY_RULE AS TRADEDAY_RULE, F.HDAY_OPEN_FLAG AS HDAY_OPEN_FLAG, F.CALC_RULE AS CALC_RULE, F.CPRICE_RULE AS CPRICE_RULE, F.CREATE_USER AS CREATE_USER, F.CREATE_DEPT AS CREATE_DEPT, F.CREATE_TIME AS CREATE_TIME, F.UPDATE_USER AS UPDATE_USER, F.UPDATE_TIME AS UPDATE_TIME, G.Pur_Speed AS purConfDays FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN (SELECT T.CASH_ID, T.OPEN_TYPE, T.OPEN_DATE_END, T.OPEN_VDATE, T.OPEN_MDATE, T.FINPROD_ID, T.RN FROM (SELECT B.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, C.OPEN_TYPE AS OPEN_TYPE, C.OPEN_DATE_END AS OPEN_DATE_END, C.open_date_str AS OPEN_VDATE, C.open_date_end AS OPEN_MDATE, C.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASH_ID,C.OPEN_TYPE ORDER BY C.OPEN_VDATE DESC) RN FROM FIN_CASH_INFO B INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN C ON B.CASH_ID = C.CASH_ID WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashFinprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType1} AND B.BRANCH = 0 ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 AND T.OPEN_VDATE between TRUNC(to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),'mm') and trunc(add_months(to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),1),'mm')-1 ) E ON A.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND D.ISSUE_STATUS = #{issueStatus} INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE F ON E.CASH_ID = F.CASH_ID AND E.OPEN_TYPE = F.OPEN_TYPE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD G ON A.FINPROD_ID = G.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType} AND A.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
AND A.OPERATION_TYPE = #{operationType}

select DISTINCT '业绩回补计划' planType,/*计划类型*/ R.CAWLBACK_RULE anapleroticRule,/*回补方式*/ R.CAWLBACK_TYPE anapleroticType, /*回补形式*/ R.Basis anapleroticBasic,/* 计费基数*/ R.Eff_Date effDate,/* 生效日*/ E.cash_id anapleroticId,/*回补id*/ A.FINPROD_ID finprodId,/*产品代码*/ A.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, /*交易日历*/ I.PROD_STYLE prodStyle,/* 适用款型*/ O.OPEN_CYCLE_UNIT anapleroticFrequency, /*回补规则*/ O.TRADEDAY_RULE cycleTdayRule,/*营业日准则*/ E.ACCR_STR_DATE firstAnapleroticDate, /* 首次回补日*/ D.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, /* 回补计提结束日*/ S.Accr_Str_Date firstAnapleroticCycleBegDate,/*首次回补周期结束日*/ D.F_ACCR_END_DATE firstAnapleroticCycleEndDate,/* 首次回补周期结束日*/ F.COEFFICIENT*100 anapleroticRatio /* 回补比例*/ from fin_product A INNER JOIN( SELECT T.CASH_ID, T.ACCR_STR_DATE, T.ACCR_END_DATE, T.FINPROD_ID, T.RN FROM (SELECT B.CASH_ID AS CASH_ID, C.ACCR_STR_DATE AS ACCR_STR_DATE, C.ACCR_END_DATE AS ACCR_END_DATE, B.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASH_ID ORDER BY C.ACCR_END_DATE DESC) RN FROM FIN_CASH_INFO B INNER JOIN FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE C ON B.CASH_ID = C.CASH_ID WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashFinprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType1} AND B.BRANCH = 0 ) T WHERE T.RN = 1 AND T.ACCR_STR_DATE between TRUNC(to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),'mm') and trunc(add_months(to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),1),'mm')-1 )E ON A.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN Fin_Float_Counting_Rule D ON D.CASH_ID = E.CASH_ID INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN P ON P.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE O ON O.CASH_ID = P.CASH_ID INNER JOIN Fin_Float_Calc_Rule_Detail F ON F.CASH_ID = E.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM I ON I.FINPROD_ID = E.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CLAWBACK_CALC_RULE R ON R.CASH_ID = E.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN (select sc.CASH_ID,min(sc.Accr_Str_Date) Accr_Str_Date from FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE sc group by sc.CASH_ID) S ON S.CASH_ID = E.CASH_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16'

select TT.listN from ( select decode(t1.PROFIT_TYPE,'01',t.OPEN_NDATE,'03',t.OPEN_DATE_END) as listN from FIN_OPEN_PLAN t left join FIN_PRODUCT t1 on t1.FINPROD_ID=t.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_OPEN_RULE t2 on t2.CASH_ID=t.CASH_ID where t1.PROFIT_TYPE in('01','03') and t2.OPEN_MODE !='02' /*非高频开放*/ and t.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} )TT order by TT.listN

select DISTINCT t1.cash_id as cashId,t.vdate,t.mdate, t2.F_ACCR_DATE as provisionfirstday,t2.E_ACCR_DATE as eAccrDate from FIN_PRODUCT t left join FIN_CASH_INFO t1 on t1.finprod_id=t.finprod_id and t1.CASH_TYPE_2='C04' and t1.BRANCH = 0 left join FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE t2 on t2.cash_id=t1.cash_id where t.finprod_id=#{finprodId}
